about: Results decided off the pitch, read on the competition's or the sports court's own site. The audits count them at their official score in table and Football-Data checks; our fixtures keep the played score (bookmakers settle on it; the models read it). Keyed by the provider's fixture id.

decisions.match: 1. FC Union Berlin v VfL Bochum, Bundesliga 2024/25 match day 14, 14 Dec 2024
decisions.basis: DFB Sports Court, 9 Jan 2025: awarded 0-2 to Bochum (lighter thrown at Bochum's goalkeeper); appeal rejected by the DFB Federal Court, 28 Feb 2025
